outcomes.name: Required capability levels have been defined and assessed
outcomes.description: The organisation understands the capabilities needed to operate effectively in the future state and has assessed current capability gaps.

outcomes.name: People can perform confidently in the future state
outcomes.description: Individuals are supported to apply knowledge and skills in practice and demonstrate increasing confidence in new ways of working.

outcomes.name: Capability and confidence are sustained and continuously improved
outcomes.description: Capability levels are monitored, confidence is reinforced and continuous improvement mechanisms are in place.

actions.action: Define the future-state capabilities required for successful performance.
Conduct capability analysis to identify gaps between current and future-state capability requirements.
Assess current confidence levels amongst impacted stakeholder groups.
Identify factors that may increase or reduce stakeholder confidence.
Identify capability-related risks that could affect successful adoption.
Develop capability-building interventions to address identified capability gaps.
Provide opportunities for practical application of learning in real or simulated environments.
Provide coaching, mentoring and peer support for individuals applying new skills.
Communicate expectations regarding performance, proficiency and future-state behaviours.
Establish measures to assess capability development and confidence growth.
Gather feedback about confidence levels and practical challenges experienced by users.
Assess practical capability through observation, walkthroughs or structured validation activities.
Target additional support towards individuals or groups with lower confidence levels.
Monitor capability and confidence risks during implementation.
Review capability and confidence measures through programme governance.
